review.notes: Full review. Gate: all checks OK at 2891d49; lake env lean on Suggested.lean exit 0 with 12 sorry warnings only; depcheck 0 problems. Seeded sample 0.1-3.4 verified in kollar2012 (arXiv 0812.3608v2), raicu2010 (arXiv 0905.4805v2), Stacks groupoids chapter (022P, 03BE, 03BJ, 03BM), FGA III (Numdam) and SGA 3 Exp. V (Gille-Polo re-edition); Mathlib and Tau Ceti declarations opened at the pins; ModularCurves 0C and SSF 1.5/1.17 resolved on main. Independent recomputation over Q and nine prime fields confirms 3.1, 3.2 (52 > 51 in degree 5, lengths 15/16) and 3.3, and the exponent-triple Check. Findings: P2 Tau Ceti at the pin already proves SGA 3 V 4.1 affine case (TauCeti.AlgebraicGeometry.Quotient.EquivalenceRelation) and must be the supplier of 2.1 and of 0.3's Spec step, not ModularCurves 0C; P3 wrong dimension values in 1.1/3.1 Checks (125/124 and 0,2,13,47 should be 44/43 and 0,2,9,23); P3 FGA page 212-04 for the colimit remark; P3 unsourced Buffalo 1973 claim; P3 process narrative in 3.2; P3 module docstring lists non-targets as not stated.
